purpose: Development diagnostic only: locate original reference spans with a fixed128-code-point anchor, treating ASCII space and NBSP alike only for anchor lookup. Strict scoring and traced original characters remain unchanged. No adaptive anchor length, best occurrence, output repair or best-of profile selection.
normalization: Unchanged strict ASCII-whitespace collapse. NBSP equivalence is a one-UTF16-unit anchor search projection only; original offsets, strict matches, reference identities and all edit operations remain original.
trace_policy: One bounded original-code-point Levenshtein trace after unique fixed anchors. Preserve visited optimal-predecessor ties as diagnostic uncertainty.
unlocated_policy: Retain short, missing, duplicate, reversed and over-budget cases without selecting occurrences or falling back to other anchor lengths.
